create_dataset_ucf: create a UCF dataset instance from UCF101 with custom annotation path and frames per clip
build_video_clips: build a UCF dataset that retrieves video clips with frame rate and fold configuration
test_getitem: test the UCF dataset __getitem__ method to return video, label, video index, and clip index
review_ucf_class: review the UCF class that extends torchvision UCF101 with custom __getitem__ behavior
run_transform_pipeline: run the UCF dataset with a transform applied to each video clip before returning
